response.question: Find the maximum clique.

options.title: Find the largest fully connected group
options.description: Exact maximum clique, optionally all tied optima. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Original GPU witnesses are checked by native coloring or exact search; ties use native materialization.

options.title: Find complete groups that cannot be extended
options.description: Exact maximal cliques in an undirected simple projection. Drop loops and duplicate edges; ignore weights. Original GPU kernels supply a count, with bounded C++ materialization and explicit list completeness.
options.explanation: Computes a different result; choose it only if that is what you want.

measurement_notes: One attempt per question, including product retries and answer composition; fixture setup is timed separately.
Real current lanes are recorded without translating calculation into lookup or options.
Selected-card request fields are sent unchanged; an unsupported request contract counts as a failure.
Data answers require structured evidence; prose semantics and general explanation quality are not human-reviewed.
No production writes, training captures, or persistent development configuration changes.
Observed timings include local server/cache conditions and are not controlled performance benchmarks.
